item.title: 🚨 CVE-2026-120539 — Produit N/A · CVSS 9,8
item.content:encoded:
Pourquoi cette alerte : CVSS 9,8, exploitable par le réseau sans authentification, produit surveillé (php).

CVE-2026-120539
CVSS 9,8 (v3.1)
EPSS 0,022 · p82,6
KEV non

Vecteur : CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

The Restrictions for BuddyPress plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Remote Code Execution in all versions up to, and including, 1.5.4 This is due to the plugin splicing the attacker-controlled request URI into a PHP expression inside a double-quoted string and evaluating it with eval(). Because PHP interpolates double-quoted strings, a payload of the form {${...}} in the URL path is executed during interpolation, so no quote breakout is required and WordPress' slashing does not mitigate it. This makes it possible for unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code on the server with a single GET request. The affected conditions ship enabled by default and are evaluated before any logged-in check, so no plugin configuration is needed; the site must have BuddyPress and Paid Memberships Pro active alongside this plugin.

item.title: 🚨 CVE-2026-90436 — Apache Axis · KEV · CVSS 9,8
item.content:encoded:
Pourquoi cette alerte : ajoutée au catalogue KEV de la CISA : exploitation active confirmée.

Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability

CVE-2026-90436
CVSS 9,8 (v3.1)
EPSS 0,038 · p90,3
KEV oui, ajout le 2026-11-18

Vecteur : CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** Deserialization of an inbound SOAP fault in Apache Axis 1.x allows unauthenticated remote class instantiation. When a SOAP <Fault> carries a <detail><exceptionName> element, Axis loads the named class and, if a String <data> element is also present, instantiates it through its String constructor before checking that it is an AxisFault. Loading alone runs the class's static initializer. With a suitable class on the application's classpath this leads to remote code execution. The fault is parsed while the engine resolves the target service, before any per-service handler chain runs, so authentication handlers configured on a service do not protect against it. This affects all Apache Axis 1.x versions through 1.4. As Axis 1 has been EOL we recommend you migrate to a different SOAP engine, such as Apache Axis 2/Java. Alternatively you could use a build of Axis with the patch from https://github.com/apache/axis-axis1-java/commit/41f3b4e8d04e310ca81f86b92630ab2c11d608bd applied. The Apache Axis project does not expect to create an Axis 1.x release fixing this problem.

Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

Vanderbilt University Research Electronic Data Capture (REDCap) Code Injection Vulnerability

CVE-2026-90817
CVSS 9,8 (v3.1)
EPSS 0,343 · p98,4
KEV oui, ajout le 2026-11-18

Vecteur : CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

An unauthenticated Remote Code Execution vulnerability was found in the survey passthrough routing and Data Import processing logic, in which a malicious user could potentially exploit it by manipulating HTTP requests to access an unintended controller route from a public survey context and by supplying a crafted file-path/stream parameter during import handling. If successfully exploited, this could allow the attacker to remotely execute arbitrary code on the REDCap server. The attacker does not have to be authenticated in order to exploit this, but exploitation requires knowledge of a valid public survey hash. This vulnerability exists in REDCap 13.3.0 and higher.

item.title: 🚨 CVE-2026-76466 — Cisco Expressway Series · KEV · CVSS 9,8
item.content:encoded:
Pourquoi cette alerte : ajoutée au catalogue KEV de la CISA : exploitation active confirmée.

Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability

CVE-2026-76466
CVSS 9,8 (v3.1)
EPSS 0,022 · p82,9
KEV oui, ajout le 2026-11-20

Vecteur : CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

A vulnerability in the database service feature of Cisco Expressway Series could allow an unauthenticated, remote attacker with network access to a Cisco Expressway device to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root. This vulnerability is due to the use of persistent cookies. Additionally, there is insufficient validation of client certificates when the TLS Verify Mode is set to Enabled for clustering, which means that client certificates are not validated. An attacker with possession of the cookies could exploit this vulnerability by connecting to the database service and invoking specific remote procedure call (RPC) commands. A successful exploit could allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands as root on the underlying operating system of an affected device. Note: Cisco Expressway Series refers to Cisco Expressway Core (Expressway-C) devices and Cisco Expressway Edge (Expressway-E) devices.

item.title: 🚨 CVE-2026-129448 — Apache Roller · KEV · CVSS 9,8
item.content:encoded:
Pourquoi cette alerte : ajoutée au catalogue KEV de la CISA : exploitation active confirmée.

Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability

CVE-2026-129448
CVSS 9,8 (v3.1)
EPSS 0,055 · p92,9
KEV oui, ajout le 2026-11-20

Vecteur : CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H

Deserialization of Untrusted Data in Apache Roller versions 4.0.0 through 6.1.4 allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code. The XML-RPC endpoint accepts vendor extension types and deserializes them before authenticating the requester. This is the same vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384, which listed only Apache Roller 6.1.5 as affected. This issue is being actively exploited. Users are recommended to upgrade to Apache Roller 6.1.6 or later, which disables the extension types and rejects XML-RPC requests when the XML-RPC feature is disabled. Users who cannot upgrade right away should set "enabledForExtensions" to "false" in WEB-INF/web.xml, or remove the "/roller-services/xmlrpc" servlet mapping, and restart Roller. Disabling XML-RPC in the administration UI is not enough, because older versions deserialize the request before checking that setting.
